description: A sampler with no files: every sound is rendered from nothing by one of twenty-eight generators, on a background thread, and a fresh one is made at each press of the generate button

params.text: Chooses which generator renders the next sample, one detent per engine, with the last position rolling one at random from the pool set on the menu
Renders a new sample; the lamp is lit while the worker thread is busy and the old sample keeps playing until the new one lands, with requests during a render ignored
Starts the sample, and acts as a gate while it is held down if the trigger mode switch is set to gate
Sets the playback rate, a tenth of normal speed at the bottom of its travel to twice at the top
Sets how much of the buffer is played, measured from its start and never less than 30ms, with soft edges to the window
Chooses what happens at the end of the window: One-shot stops there, Loop wraps back through a 25ms equal-power seam and skips the buffer's own fade-in on later laps so a drone holds its level
Chooses how the trigger jack is read: Trigger takes rising edges, Gate follows the level

inputs.text: A rising edge through 1V renders a new sample
Shifts the playback rate around the speed knob, one volt per octave
Starts the sample on a rising edge through 1V, or holds it playing while above 1V if the trigger mode switch is set to gate

outputs.text: A trigger at the end of each pass through the play window

notes: nothing is loaded until generate is pressed or a trigger reaches its jack. The play controls do nothing until there is a sample.
every engine, the random position included, derives its sound from the sample's own seed, so a reloaded patch comes back with the same sound.
generating never starts or stops playback: a stopped module stays quiet when a new sample lands.
menu: Engine — the same list of generators as the knob's detents, for when the wanted one is known by name
Random pool — a tick per generator saying which the knob's random position may land on, with an Enable all at the top; two self-finishing engines are never rolled

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
